name: Tomaselli Gelateria
kurzbeschreibung:
**Tomaselli Gelateria in Innsbruck** – a true gem for ice cream lovers! Since 1998, this family-run gelateria has been crafting **handmade gelato** with the finest ingredients from **Tirol** and beyond. Their menu features classic flavors like **Vanille**, **Schokolade**, and **Stracciatella**, as well as seasonal specialties such as **Erdbeere** (strawberry) or **Zitrone** (lemon). Don’t miss their **Kaiserschmarrn**-inspired creations or the **Apfelstrudel** gelato—perfect for a sweet treat after a day exploring **Innsbruck**’s charming streets. A must-visit for anyone with a sweet tooth!
